variants: All 52 entries inspected on bare bases and with default hair. Hurt eyes retain > <; 02 has larger curved closed lids, 03 flatter closed lids. Brows and mouth expression variants remain independently selectable.
limitations: This is visual review of native reference-player output, not user approval or an in-game usability study.
Nose and small-mouth choices are less salient than eyes and brows at 80px; movement, display scaling and game background can reduce legibility.
The accepted v2 head and hair remain unchanged, so overall head contour is not pixel-identical to the approved lineup.
